description: He has said he wants to understand the passage and is not learning Greek: the tutor quizzes to match in plain English, asks once whether this is how he wants to be quizzed from now on, and offers the goal in quiz_goal_offer.

request.greek: Οὐδὲν ἄρα νῦν κατάκριμα τοῖς ἐν χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ μὴ κατὰ σάρκα περιπατοῦσιν ἀλλὰ κατὰ πνεῦμα
request.english: Therefore there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus, who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.
request.question: I just want to understand what Paul is saying. I'm not learning Greek.
